reviews.t: Holy Grail of Fragrance Free Haircare
reviews.x: I have *seriously* sensitive skin and cannot use any personal care product which contains fragrance (even some "natural" fragrances bother me).  I have been on the search for fragrance free hair care for about 3 years.  What I have found is fragrance free hair products are either terrible for your hair or they're not truly fragrance free and still irritating.  Well, I finally can stop my search.  This stuff is truly fragrance free and the use of ceramides has improved the condition of my scalp a

reviews.t: Soft beautiful hair without sensitivity reaction
reviews.x: I have a very sensitive scalp. I cannot tolerate products with formaldehyde or perfumes. This is the first shampoo and conditioner product that I have found that I can tolerate. Not only do I not have a sensitivity reaction but my hair is soft and beautiful. I love this product so much! This is the first amazon review I have ever done only because this product is amazing! I use both the shampoo and conditioner.

This is my favorite fragrance free shampoo (and I have tried many.). Good lather, moisturizing, doesn't strip my hair, yet rinses clean.  The conditioner is A-Mazing.  I think it is my favorite conditioner of any I have every tried-including scented ones!  Leaves my thick, curly hair so soft and can comb right through it.  There is nothing bad to say about this product!  I think I just found my holy grail!

reviews.t: Best that I’ve found so far
reviews.x: I have severe skin sensitivity and I was losing my hair. This product stopped the itching scalp and like a flip of a switch, stopped my hair loss. Non drying and very subtle scent.

reviews.t: This will be my forever conditioner
reviews.x: I purchased the shampoo and conditioner. My hair is normal to dry, uncolored with a bit of gray. I have slightly wavy hair, but i am not trying to bring out any curl, so I can't tell if it would be good for curlies. That being said, the shampoo is very clarifying, and it dries out my hair, so I only use it occassionally. For someone with oilier hair, it would work well. The conditioner is fabulous! My hair feels so silky smooth and healthy. I have struggled with conditioners because most are too

This is wonderful shampoo.  I'm so glad I tried it. I'm going to stick with it.  I hate perfumes in my shampoo and this has only the slightest citrus smell.  VERY minor smell.  I have very fine, short hair so I was looking for something that wasn't a big heavy glop of gunk.  The shampoo got my hair really clean and the conditioner left my hair really soft.  And it's really inexpensive as well.  I recommend it highly.

I have a very sensitive scalp and also use henna to color my hair, so finding a shampoo that is safe for my color and is gentle on my scalp has been difficult. This one is amazing - I love that there's no dyes or fragrances to mess with my allergies and it doesn't irritate my scalp.

I didn't order the Earth Science Shampoo and Conditioner on Amazon as I didn't want to wait for delivery, so I bought it for a few dollars more at my local natural store.  I've used the shampoo and conditioner just once but so far I really like the product. It's truly fragrance free (I'm chemically sensitive), and it has made my waist length curly hair feel absolutely wonderful. Detangling after my regular shampoo and conditioner is normally an exhausting affair but with the Earth Science I saw

I had my husband smell it before using and he said there is Fragrance..... Looked in the label and one of the ingredients is LAVENDAR! That is a fragrant herb. This is totally false advertising! Since I had the product over 30 days I can’t return. I would have broke out in a rash and got a migraine if I hadn’t checked before using!  You should really refund my money Amazon and Earth Science!

reviews.t: No allergy issues and works great!
reviews.x: I'm allergic to...a lot, so I had a really hard time finding shampoo and conditioner that I liked and that I wasn't allergic to. This works really well for my hair (fine, but lots of it and color treated) and causes no allergy issues! Plus it lathers, and a lot of the stripped down shampoos don't.

reviews.t: No fragrance, No more scalp itching!
reviews.x: 48 yo and didn’t know or have just with in the last year become sensitive to fragrance on my scalp.  Started using this and the scalp itchiness is gone.  The shampoo is a little drying so I use a lot of the conditioner to follow up.
I love this fragrance free, no scent shampoo and conditioner. As I get older, my hair is more dry. I really like this. My hair is wavy and is manageable with this! The shampoo is not too stripping.

reviews.t: Best sensitive set I’ve tried so far!
reviews.x: I have tried sooo many products that either make my scalp itch or my hair dry and frizzy. This is the first one I’ve tried that leaves my hair soft without irritating my scalp.
I've been using these products for over a year. They are truly scent free and do an excellent job. Highly recommend these products. Says it's made in USA

Update ~ I still love this product. I wish the packaging for shipping was more secure. It often arrives leaking shampoo. Please pack it in a box, the bubble envelopes aren’t enough~  I’ve been using this shampoo and conditioner for a few months and love how healthy my hair feels. It hasn’t been easy finding unscented shampoo and conditioner, this was the third product I’ve tried and it’s a keeper. Great for anyone with a sensitivity to artificial fragrances and dyes or as a clarifying break from

Like the headlines says, it still has a smell like old lady lotion (reminds me of old school oil of olay my grandmother loved), but more of a lavender scent when hair dries. While not too strong compared to others out there, it’s still disappointing when you wanted something with no smell. The majority of the smell came from the shampoo and didn’t notice as much of a smell coming from the conditioner so the conditioner might be usable.  As others complained, the cap arrived loose so the shampoo

I have sensitive skin and I bought this set of shampoo and conditioner because it said "NO FRAGRANCE".  However it DOES have essential oils in them.....lots of it.  It made me have the worst breakout I have ever had.  My skin is so irritated I can hardly sit down.  My face is swollen and my eyes feel like fire.  I can hardly stay awake. I have had to take so much antihistamine to help the breathing and the itching.  I should have been more diligent and read the label better.  Be careful with thi

I would say if you have really dry hair and need something to condition your hair especially during winter this is an excellent shampoo for that. Unfortunately I can not handle fragrance in any of my product any more and this one is truly fragrance free. However my scalp is prone to oiliness so I can not use this daily it is to much. However when I am having dry spells this helps out tremendously. Proceed with caution if you are the same scalp type

I am sensitive to fragrances, on my skin and by scent. It’s hit or miss so even no added fragrance can still trigger something. My hair and scalp feel great after using this. The shampoo really makes my hair feel clean, and the conditioner is light. Neither have any scent. I have very fine hair, so if the conditioner is heavy, it just goes limp, too light and I’m set with a staticky mess. This leaves my hair feeling soft and manageable.

I was nervous that it would hit the fragrance-free target but not the 'actually makes my hair feel/look nice' target and I am so happy I was wrong! My hair is coarse and 4c curly, I am hispanic. I liked this so much I ordered another set as soon as I used it!  This doesn't bother my (moderate) asthma or (severe) allergies AT ALL. I am so happy I found it!

I have relaxed hair and have been using this shampoo and conditioner for almost a year, and I am happy with it. I have had fewer skin irritations with this shampoo. The conditioner leaves my hair soft and manageable. There is a slight smell, but it smells similar to a shampoo my dermatologist had prescribed which was also fragrance-free.

reviews.t: No irritation for individual allergic to fragrances
reviews.x: I really love this shampoo - it makes my hair so soft.  I am extremely sensitive to fragrances and this one doesn't cause any irritation.  I just wish it was a little less expensive.  It's about three times as much as my regular shampoo and conditioner so I only use it once in a while.  But it is better than the normal stuff I use.

I have extremely dry skin and have struggled my whole life to find something that would work for my scalp. My scalp does not itch at all whatsoever after using this product. I used to scratch so much that people thought I had lice. Also, my son has eczema verse making his scalp extra flaky. This fixed everything for all of us.

I have used this shampoo for years (and both purchased from stores and amazon) and it is obvious the shampoo and conditioner have been refilled with another product. The products never have a smell, and now they do, the color of the shampoo has a blue tinge, and overall, a totally different consistency. Buyer beware!

My hair tends to get frizzy in humid weather, and this cond. really makes a difference. I don't like to rinse any conditioner out completely, just to keep the frizz down. With some anti-frizz conditioners I can't do that because the smell is too strong. This one actually has zero fragrance, so it's not a problem.

claims.text: Many reviewers with sensitive skin or allergies say the products are gentle and don't irritate their scalp or cause reactions.
Reviewers frequently praise the products as truly fragrance-free or having only a very slight scent.
Several reviewers say the shampoo and conditioner leave their hair soft, moisturized, and manageable.
Some reviewers note the shampoo can be drying or stripping, requiring conditioner to follow up.
One reviewer disputes the fragrance-free claim, saying the product contains lavender and caused a reaction.
